Message:
drm/i915: Use PIPE_CONF_CHECK_X() for sync_mode_slaves_mask

sync_mode_slaves_mask is a bitmask so use PIPE_CONF_CHECK_X() for it
so we get the mismatch printed in hex instead of decimal.
